title: I turned my one-shot  GTA into an 8-player multiplayer browser game
author: ledniv
selftext:
I started with a GTA-style driving sandbox made from a single prompt: a low-poly city, traffic, cars you could steal, and plenty of things to crash into.

Redditors asked for multiplayer, weapons, and people to run over.

It’s now called **Grand Total Anarchy**, an online deathmatch game for up to eight players. Steal a car, grab a weapon, and be the first to reach ten kills.

You can jump straight into a public match or create a private room for friends. Bots fill empty slots and are automatically replaced as players join.

You can play it in your browser here:

[https://gta.nitzan.games](https://gta.nitzan.games/)

I’d love to hear what you'd like me to add or change!

  
The original one-shot prompt plus repo can be found here: [https://nitzan.games/OneShotGTA.html](https://nitzan.games/OneShotGTA.html)

comments.author: matTmin45
comments.body: Just tried it, it's playable and fun. Can't believe we're entering an era of infinite self-made games. Maybe one day, we'll just generate games instead of buying them. Does it sound crazy ?
